authority_source: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Healthy Rice Leaf.description: The rice leaf specimen exhibits normal morphological characteristics with uniform chlorophyll-rich green coloration, erect blade posture, and absence of necrotic lesions, chlorotic halos, or foliar blights.
Healthy Rice Leaf.symptoms: Uniform deep green leaf blade, intact cuticle, smooth linear venation, no water-soaked margins or necrotic lesions.
Healthy Rice Leaf.favorable_conditions: Optimal agronomic conditions including balanced macronutrient availability (N-P-K), adequate soil moisture, proper plant spacing, and normal solar radiation.
Healthy Rice Leaf.contributing_factors: Balanced fertilization, disease-free certified seed stock, clean irrigation channels, and proper nursery management.
Healthy Rice Leaf.prevention: Maintain balanced N-P-K fertilizer split applications (avoid excess urea). Practice recommended planting density (20 × 15 cm) to maintain canopy ventilation. Inspect field weekly during tillering and panicle initiation.
Healthy Rice Leaf.management: Continue routine crop monitoring and standard agronomic care. Ensure field bund sanitation and maintain clean irrigation water flow.
Healthy Rice Leaf.expert_consultation: Consult local agricultural extension officers if localized yellowing or nutrient deficiency symptoms (such as nitrogen or zinc deficiency) appear on older foliage.

Brown Spot.description: A major fungal foliar disease of rice associated with nutrient-deficient, light-textured, or drought-stressed soils.
Brown Spot.symptoms: Circular to oval sesame seed-shaped brown lesions with distinct darker reddish-brown margins and lighter brown or grayish centers. Lesions primarily visible across leaf blades; in severe infections, lesions may coalesce into larger necrotic patches and affect sheaths and glumes.
Brown Spot.favorable_conditions: Warm temperatures (approximately 25–30°C), high relative humidity (above 85–90%), prolonged leaf wetness or dew deposition, and nutrient-deficient or moisture-stressed soil environments.
Brown Spot.contributing_factors: Deficiencies in soil potassium, manganese, silicon, or nitrogen; sandy/leached soils; intermittent drought stress; use of uncertified infected seed stock.
Brown Spot.prevention: Correct soil nutrient imbalances through balanced N-P-K applications supplemented with potassium and micronutrients (Zinc/Silicon). Use certified disease-free seeds. Treat seeds prior to sowing with recommended protective fungicide or hot water (52–54°C for 10 min).
Brown Spot.management: Apply evidence-based foliar protective or systemic fungicides (such as Mancozeb, Propiconazole, or Tricyclazole + Mancozeb formulations) strictly in accordance with local agricultural recommendations and label instructions. Avoid water stress by maintaining optimal irrigation depth.
Brown Spot.expert_consultation: Seek immediate agricultural expert consultation if lesions cover more than 15–20% of the upper canopy foliage during the maximum tillering or panicle initiation stages, or if widespread seedling blight is observed.

Leaf Smut.description: A fungal disease typically appearing during later reproductive crop growth stages as small, slightly raised angular black spots on mature leaves.
Leaf Smut.symptoms: Small, angular, lead-black to dark brown slightly raised spots (0.5 to 2 mm) scattered across both upper and lower leaf surfaces. Spots are clearly distinct from circular brown spot lesions and do not exhibit large chlorotic halos.
Leaf Smut.favorable_conditions: High relative humidity, dense crop canopies, shaded lower canopy foliage, and warm humid weather during the heading to grain maturation stages.
Leaf Smut.contributing_factors: Excessive late-season nitrogen top-dressing, high planting density reducing air movement, and mature senescing leaf tissues.
Leaf Smut.prevention: Adhere to recommended hill spacing to ensure canopy aeration. Avoid excessive late-season nitrogen application. Deeply plow crop residues into soil following harvest to reduce fungal overwintering inoculum.
Leaf Smut.management: In most commercial fields, leaf smut occurs late in the season and rarely requires intensive chemical interventions. If severe early outbreaks occur, apply labeled broad-spectrum protective fungicides (e.g., Mancozeb or Propiconazole) following local extension guidelines.
Leaf Smut.expert_consultation: Consult an agronomist if dark sooty spots appear on flag leaves prior to 50% flowering or if premature leaf desiccation threatens grain filling.

Bacterial Leaf Blight.description: A destructive systemic vascular bacterial disease affecting irrigated and lowland rice ecosystems.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.symptoms: Water-soaked to yellowish-green marginal stripes initiating near leaf tips and edges. Lesions enlarge longitudinally with characteristic wavy/undulating margins, turning bleached straw-yellow to grayish-white. Amber-colored bacterial ooze droplets may form along veins in humid early mornings.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.favorable_conditions: Warm temperatures (25–34°C), high relative humidity (above 80–95%), continuous overcast/rainy days, standing floodwaters, and wind-driven rainstorms causing foliage micro-abrasions.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.contributing_factors: Excessive nitrogenous fertilization, close plant spacing, deep stagnant field water, and cultivation of susceptible cultivars.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.prevention: Plant resistant or tolerant cultivars (e.g., IR64, Improved Samba Mahsuri). Adopt split nitrogen applications (avoid top-dressing during active outbreaks). Disinfect seed stock with Streptocycline or hot water.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.management: Drain stagnant field water temporarily to lower relative humidity within the canopy. Apply registered bactericides/copper formulations (e.g., Copper Hydroxide or Copper Oxychloride + Streptocycline) as per official extension advisory.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.expert_consultation: Immediately contact an agricultural extension officer if the systemic 'Kresek' (seedling wilt) phase occurs or if marginal blighting advances rapidly on upper flag leaves.

Rice Blast.description: One of the most destructive rice diseases globally, capable of affecting leaf blades, collars, nodes, and panicle necks.
Rice Blast.symptoms: Characteristic diamond-shaped, spindle-shaped, or elliptical lesions with pointed acute ends, grayish-white necrotic centers, and distinct reddish-brown to dark brown margins. Lesions can rapidly enlarge and coalesce, causing complete foliar burning.
Rice Blast.favorable_conditions: Cool night temperatures (18–24°C) with warm humid days, prolonged leaf wetness (dew duration > 10–12 hours), high relative humidity (> 90%), and overcast rainy weather.
Rice Blast.contributing_factors: Excessive nitrogen fertilizer application, dry soil conditions in upland cultivation, high planting density, and susceptible varieties.
Rice Blast.prevention: Plant blast-resistant varieties. Divide nitrogen application into 3–4 balanced splits. Maintain continuous shallow flooding (2–5 cm) in lowland fields to minimize blast predisposition. Seed treatment with Tricyclazole.
Rice Blast.management: Apply certified blast-specific fungicides (e.g., Tricyclazole, Isoprothiolane, or Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole) at the earliest appearance of spindle lesions, especially at late tillering and boot stages.
Rice Blast.expert_consultation: Urgent expert consultation is recommended upon identifying spindle lesions during the booting or heading stages to prevent catastrophic neck blast.

Sheath Blight.description: A soil- and water-borne fungal disease initiating on lower leaf sheaths near the waterline and progressing upward.
Sheath Blight.symptoms: Oval, elliptical, or irregular greenish-gray water-soaked blotches with dark reddish-brown borders. Lesions coalesce into large 'snake-skin' banded patterns across sheaths and lower leaf blades, often with visible white mycelia or brown sclerotia.
Sheath Blight.favorable_conditions: High temperatures (28–32°C), high canopy humidity (85–100%), dense foliage, and floating fungal sclerotia in irrigation water.
Sheath Blight.contributing_factors: Heavy nitrogen application, dense hill spacing (less than 15 cm), poor field drainage, and weed growth along field bunds.
Sheath Blight.prevention: Adopt wider plant spacing (20 × 20 cm) for canopy ventilation. Avoid excess nitrogen. Maintain clean field bunds. Apply bio-control agents (Trichoderma viride) to nursery soil.
Sheath Blight.management: Apply labeled fungicides (such as Validamycin, Hexaconazole, or Azoxystrobin) directed towards the base of tillers during the late tillering/booting stages.
Sheath Blight.expert_consultation: Consult an agronomist if lesions reach the upper third of the plant canopy or flag leaf sheath prior to panicle emergence.

False Smut.description: A floral fungal disease converting individual developing grains on the panicle into large velvety smut balls.
False Smut.symptoms: Individual grains transform into swollen, round, velvety greenish-yellow to dark olive-green balls (smut balls) up to 1 cm or more in diameter, containing powdery chlamydospores.
False Smut.favorable_conditions: High relative humidity (> 90%), moderate temperatures (25–30°C), cloudy overcast days, and rainfall during the flowering and grain-filling stages.
False Smut.contributing_factors: Excessive nitrogen application during late reproductive stages and late transplanting.
False Smut.prevention: Use certified disease-free seed stock. Avoid high nitrogen dosages at panicle initiation. Time transplanting to avoid flowering during peak late-season rains.
False Smut.management: Apply prophylactic foliar fungicides (such as Copper Hydroxide or Propiconazole) at the boot-leaf stage (5–7 days before panicle emergence). Chemical sprays are ineffective once smut balls are formed.
False Smut.expert_consultation: Consult extension staff if more than 5% of panicles show smut ball development to establish safe post-harvest grain handling and milling protocols.

Tungro.description: A devastating viral disease complex transmitted semi-persistently by the Green Leafhopper (Nephotettix virescens).
Tungro.symptoms: Severe plant stunting, reduced tiller production, delayed flowering. Leaves display characteristic yellow to orange-yellow chlorotic discoloration beginning at leaf tips and progressing down margins, with rusty brown necrotic speckles on older leaves.
Tungro.favorable_conditions: Warm humid conditions favoring high vector (Green Leafhopper) population growth, overlapping cropping seasons, and presence of stubble host reservoirs.
Tungro.contributing_factors: Asynchronous community planting, unmanaged leafhopper populations, and susceptible local varieties.
Tungro.prevention: Adopt synchronized community planting schedules. Plant vector- and virus-resistant cultivars. Plow under rice stubble immediately after harvest to eliminate viral reservoirs.
Tungro.management: Manage leafhopper vector populations with registered selective insecticides (e.g., Imidacloprid, Thiamethoxam, or Pymetrozine) strictly following agricultural extension thresholds. Rogue out early infected hills.
Tungro.expert_consultation: Notify local agricultural authorities immediately if yellow-orange stunting patches appear in young vegetative fields (under 30 days after transplanting).

Bacterial Leaf Streak.description: A bacterial foliar disease producing narrow, interveinal translucent streaks that turn yellow to brown.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.symptoms: Fine, narrow, translucent water-soaked streaks strictly confined between leaf veins. Tiny yellow-golden bacterial exudate beads form on lesion surfaces during high humidity. Streaks later coalesce into larger brown necrotic bands.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.favorable_conditions: Warm temperatures (28–32°C), high relative humidity (> 85%), splashing rain, and mechanical abrasive foliage damage from winds or tools.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.contributing_factors: Over-fertilization with nitrogen, dense planting, overhead sprinkler irrigation, and infected seed stock.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.prevention: Ensure certified seed sourcing. Maintain adequate plant spacing. Avoid excessive nitrogen. Eliminate diseased straw and volunteer host plants after harvest.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.management: Apply labeled bactericides (e.g., Copper Hydroxide or Kasugamycin) in early infection stages. Avoid overhead irrigation and minimize field traffic when leaves are wet.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.expert_consultation: Consult an agricultural expert if streaks rapidly spread to flag leaves during panicle emergence.

Sheath Rot.description: A fungal disease attacking the uppermost flag leaf sheath enclosing the young developing panicle.
Sheath Rot.symptoms: Oblong or irregular grayish-brown lesions with distinct dark reddish-brown margins on the flag leaf sheath. Panicles fail to emerge fully (choked panicles), resulting in unfilled, discolored, or sterile grains.
Sheath Rot.favorable_conditions: High relative humidity (85–95%), temperatures of 20–28°C, and presence of stem borer or mite injuries on the upper sheath.
Sheath Rot.contributing_factors: Dense canopies, insect injury, potash deficiency, and high humidity during boot stage.
Sheath Rot.prevention: Balanced potassium fertilization to strengthen sheath cuticle. Control stem borers and mites early. Seed treatment with Carbendazim.
Sheath Rot.management: Apply labeled foliar fungicides (e.g., Propiconazole, Carbendazim, or Azoxystrobin) at the late boot leaf stage before panicle emergence.
Sheath Rot.expert_consultation: Consult extension services if flag leaf sheath browning exceeds 20% in the field.

Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.description: A fungal disease causing numerous short, narrow, linear brown streaks parallel to leaf veins on mature crops.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.symptoms: Short, narrow, linear reddish-brown to dark brown streaks (2 to 10 mm long, 1 to 1.5 mm wide) oriented strictly parallel to the leaf veins. Clearly distinguished from Brown Spot by their linear, needle-like shape.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.favorable_conditions: Warm temperatures (25–30°C), potassium deficiencies in soil, late-season nitrogen depletion, and susceptible cultivars.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.contributing_factors: Low soil fertility, late-season moisture stress, and late-maturing varieties.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.prevention: Apply balanced potassium fertilizer. Use certified disease-free seeds. Maintain recommended spacing.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.management: Apply registered fungicides (such as Propiconazole or Azoxystrobin) during the booting to heading stages if disease spreads upward to flag leaves.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.expert_consultation: Consult an agronomist if premature leaf desiccation occurs across more than 25% of the upper canopy.

Rice Hispa.description: A destructive small spiny black beetle pest whose adults scrape leaves and larvae mine leaf tissue.
Rice Hispa.symptoms: Characteristic parallel whitish translucent streaks on the upper leaf surface caused by adult scraping. Larvae mine between leaf epidermal layers creating irregular blister-like whitish-brown blotches.
Rice Hispa.favorable_conditions: Continuous heavy rainfall followed by sunny humid weather, excessive nitrogen application, and grassy weeds along field bunds.
Rice Hispa.contributing_factors: Dense nurseries, unmanaged field borders, and high nitrogen fertilization.
Rice Hispa.prevention: Clip top tips of nursery seedlings prior to transplanting to eliminate hispa eggs. Maintain clean weed-free bunds. Avoid excess nitrogen.
Rice Hispa.management: Use sweeping nets in early nursery infestations. Apply labeled contact/systemic insecticides (e.g., Chlorpyrifos, Quinalphos, or Neem-based formulations) when economic threshold levels (> 1 adult or 1 damaged leaf per hill) are exceeded.
Rice Hispa.expert_consultation: Consult local pest monitoring units if widespread white blister patches appear in seedling or early vegetative fields.

Bacterial Panicle Blight.description: A bacterial disease causing panicle blighting, floret sterility, and grain discoloration during heading.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.symptoms: Panicles remain erect due to aborted unfilled grains; glumes display straw-yellow to dark brown discoloration with a reddish-brown margin separating healthy and diseased tissue.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.favorable_conditions: High nighttime temperatures (> 28°C) combined with high relative humidity during panicle emergence and flowering.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.contributing_factors: Warm night temperatures, high nitrogen, and delayed planting.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.prevention: Select tolerant varieties. Treat seed with hot water (55°C for 15 min). Avoid high late-season nitrogen.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.management: Apply oxolinic acid or copper formulations where registered at 10–20% flowering stage.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.expert_consultation: Consult expert agronomists if floret discoloration is accompanied by upright empty panicles.

Bakanae.description: Known as 'foolish seedling disease', caused by excess fungal gibberellin production resulting in abnormal seedling elongation.
Bakanae.symptoms: Infected seedlings and tillers are noticeably taller, slender, pale yellowish-green with reduced tillering and adventitious roots at lower stem nodes.
Bakanae.favorable_conditions: Warm nursery soil temperatures (30–35°C), high humidity, and contaminated seed beds.
Bakanae.contributing_factors: Infected seed stock and reusing infected nursery soil.
Bakanae.prevention: Seed treatment with Trichoderma harzianum (10 g/kg) or Carbendazim (2 g/kg). Rogue out abnormal tall seedlings in nursery.
Bakanae.management: Drench seedbeds with certified fungicide. Avoid reusing infected nursery beds.
Bakanae.expert_consultation: Consult agricultural officers if elongated chlorotic seedlings exceed 5% of the nursery stand.

Stem Borer Damage.description: Internal stem-tunneling insect larvae causing 'Dead Heart' in vegetative stages and 'Whitehead' in reproductive stages.
Stem Borer Damage.symptoms: Vegetative stage: central leaf whorl withers and dries up, easily pulled out ('Dead Heart'). Reproductive stage: emergence of completely white, erect, sterile panicles ('Whitehead'). Frass visible inside lower stems.
Stem Borer Damage.favorable_conditions: High humidity, continuous standing deep water, staggered planting seasons, and warm temperatures (20–30°C).
Stem Borer Damage.contributing_factors: Excess nitrogen, deep water levels, and continuous monoculture.
Stem Borer Damage.prevention: Install pheromone traps for monitoring. Clip seedling tips before transplanting. Release Trichogramma parasitoids.
Stem Borer Damage.management: Apply registered granular or foliar insecticides (e.g., Cartap Hydrochloride, Chlorantraniliprole, or Flubendiamide) when egg masses or threshold dead hearts are spotted.
Stem Borer Damage.expert_consultation: Contact extension services if dead hearts exceed 5% in vegetative stage or whiteheads exceed 2% at heading.

Rice Grassy Stunt.description: A viral disease transmitted by the Brown Planthopper causing severe stunting and excessive grassy tillering.
Rice Grassy Stunt.symptoms: Severe plant stunting with profuse, erect, narrow, pale green to yellowish-green tillers creating a dense grassy rosette appearance with rusty brown spots.
Rice Grassy Stunt.favorable_conditions: High Brown Planthopper (BPH) vector populations, warm tropical temperatures, and dense shaded crop canopies.
Rice Grassy Stunt.contributing_factors: Indiscriminate pesticide use killing natural predators (spiders, mirid bugs) and susceptible cultivars.
Rice Grassy Stunt.prevention: Plant BPH-resistant varieties. Implement Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD). Maintain 30 cm alleyways every 2 meters.
Rice Grassy Stunt.management: Manage BPH vectors using registered systemic insecticides (e.g., Pymetrozine, Triflumezopyrim, or Dinotefuran). Rogue out infected hills.
Rice Grassy Stunt.expert_consultation: Seek agricultural advice if vector planthopper hopperburn or grassy stunting is detected in early tillering.

Rice Ragged Stunt.description: A viral pathogen causing ragged leaf margins, vein swellings (galls), and twisted deformed foliage.
Rice Ragged Stunt.symptoms: Stunted hills, ragged or notched serrated leaf blade margins, twisted leaf tips, and pale yellow vein galls along leaf sheaths and blades.
Rice Ragged Stunt.favorable_conditions: High Brown Planthopper populations, continuous year-round rice cropping, and warm climate.
Rice Ragged Stunt.contributing_factors: Unmanaged vector populations and overlapping planting dates.
Rice Ragged Stunt.prevention: Synchronized community planting. Preserve natural predators. Plant resistant varieties.
Rice Ragged Stunt.management: Target BPH vectors with labeled insecticides. Remove and bury severely infected hills.
Rice Ragged Stunt.expert_consultation: Notify extension officers if leaf raggedness and vein galls are observed in vegetative fields.

Dirty Panicle.description: Post-heading grain discoloration complex affecting glumes, causing dark, spotted, or dirty appearance and reducing grain quality.
Dirty Panicle.symptoms: Discoloration of kernels and glumes with dark brown, purple, pinkish, or black spots covering part or the entire grain surface.
Dirty Panicle.favorable_conditions: Intermittent rains, high relative humidity (> 85%), and insect feeding punctures during milk and dough stages.
Dirty Panicle.contributing_factors: Late rains, insect feeding damage, and potassium deficiency.
Dirty Panicle.prevention: Clean seed sourcing, balanced fertilization with potassium, and timely harvesting at 20–22% moisture.
Dirty Panicle.management: Foliar application of registered protective fungicides (e.g., Azoxystrobin + Difenoconazole or Propiconazole) at 50% flowering.
Dirty Panicle.expert_consultation: Consult agronomists if grain discoloration exceeds 15% across the panicle stand.

Kernel Smut.description: A grain disease where individual rice kernels are converted into a black powdery mass of fungal teliospores.
Kernel Smut.symptoms: Infected kernels burst open revealing a black sooty powdery mass of spores. External symptoms appear during late grain maturity.
Kernel Smut.favorable_conditions: High relative humidity, frequent rain showers, overcast skies during flowering, and excess nitrogen.
Kernel Smut.contributing_factors: Over-fertilization with nitrogen and late planting.
Kernel Smut.prevention: Avoid excessive nitrogen top-dressing. Practice crop rotation. Treat seeds with protective fungicide.
Kernel Smut.management: Apply labeled fungicides (e.g., Propiconazole or Copper Oxychloride) during the late boot to early heading stage.
Kernel Smut.expert_consultation: Consult extension services if black sooty kernels are detected during pre-harvest field inspections.

Udbatta Disease.description: Also known as 'incense stick' disease, where infected panicles emerge as compact, cylindrical, hard grayish-white rods.
Udbatta Disease.symptoms: Diseased panicles emerge as a compact, hard, cylindrical grayish-white rod resembling an incense stick (udbatta) with zero grain setting.
Udbatta Disease.favorable_conditions: Cool humid weather at higher elevations and valleys, seed-borne infection, and fluctuating soil moisture.
Udbatta Disease.contributing_factors: Using seed from infected crops and poor nursery sanitation.
Udbatta Disease.prevention: Hot water seed treatment at 52–54°C for 10 min. Treat seed with Carbendazim (2 g/kg seed). Rogue out infected tillers.
Udbatta Disease.management: Foliar spray of Carbendazim or Mancozeb at the boot leaf stage in endemic areas.
Udbatta Disease.expert_consultation: Notify plant protection officers if cylindrical rod panicles appear in the field.

Healthy Rice Leaf.symptoms_en: Deep green leaf blade with intact margins, uniform chlorophyll distribution, and no necrotic lesions.
Healthy Rice Leaf.symptoms_kn: ಏಕರೂಪದ ಹಸಿರು ಬಣ್ಣ, ಯಾವುದೇ ಒಣಗಿದ ಕಲೆಗಳು ಅಥವಾ ರೋಗದ ಮಚ್ಚೆಗಳಿಲ್ಲದ ಆರೋಗ್ಯಕರ ಎಲೆ.
Healthy Rice Leaf.nonchemical_management_en: Maintain balanced N-P-K fertilizer split applications (avoid excess urea). Ensure standard spacing (20 × 15 cm) for optimal ventilation. Clean field bunds and maintain proper water depth (2–5 cm).
Healthy Rice Leaf.nonchemical_management_kn: ಶಿಫಾರಸು ಮಾಡಿದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಾರಜನಕ, ರಂಜಕ ಮತ್ತು ಪೊಟ್ಯಾಷ್ ಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳನ್ನು ಹಂತ-ಹಂತವಾಗಿ ನೀಡಿ (ಅತಿಯಾದ ಯೂರಿಯಾ ಬೇಡ). ಸಾಲುಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಸೂಕ್ತ ಅಂತರ ಕಾಪಾಡಿ. ಗದ್ದೆಯ ಬದುಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ವಚ್ಛವಾಗಿಡಿ.
Healthy Rice Leaf.prevention_en: Crop rotation with pulses, use of certified healthy seeds, and regular monitoring.
Healthy Rice Leaf.prevention_kn: ದ್ವಿದಳ ಧಾನ್ಯಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ಬೆಳೆ ಪರಿವರ್ತನೆ, ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕೃತ ಬೀಜಗಳ ಬಳಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಮಿತ ಕಣ್ಗಾವಲು.
Healthy Rice Leaf.label_rate: Do not apply chemical pesticides to healthy crops.
Healthy Rice Leaf.safety_precautions: Avoid unnecessary chemical applications to conserve beneficial natural predators (spiders, dragonflies).
Healthy Rice Leaf.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Rice Blast.symptoms_en: Spindle-shaped or eye-shaped lesions with gray-white centers and reddish-brown borders; node blast and neck blast causing complete grain sterility.
Rice Blast.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಣ್ಣಿನ ಆಕಾರದ (ಮಧ್ಯೆ ಬೂದು, ಸುತ್ತಲೂ ಕಂದು ಅಂಚುಳ್ಳ) ಮಚ್ಚೆಗಳು. ಕುತ್ತಿಗೆ ರೋಗ ಬಂದರೆ ತೆನೆ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಜಳ್ಳಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
Rice Blast.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Immediately stop all nitrogen (urea) top-dressing while active blast lesions are present.
2. Burn or deeply plow infected straw stubble after harvest.
3. Seed treatment before sowing: Hot water soak (52–54°C for 10 min) or Trichoderma viride bio-fungicide (10 g/kg seed).
Rice Blast.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಬೆಂಕಿ ರೋಗದ ಮಚ್ಚೆಗಳು ಕಂಡ ತಕ್ಷಣ ಯೂರಿಯಾ (ಸಾರಜನಕ) ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ನೀಡುವುದನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
2. ಕೊಯ್ಲಿನ ನಂತರ ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಕೊಳೆ-ಕಸವನ್ನು ಸುಟ್ಟು ಅಥವಾ ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ.
3. ಬಿತ್ತನೆಗೆ ಮುನ್ನ ಟ್ರೈಕೋಡರ್ಮಾ (10 ಗ್ರಾಂ/ಕೆಜಿ) ಜೈವಿಕ ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರನಾಶಕದಿಂದ ಬೀಜೋಪಚಾರ ಮಾಡಿ.
Rice Blast.prevention_en: Plant blast-resistant varieties (such as Jaya, Intan, Rasi, MTU-1010). Apply silica/potassium to harden leaf cuticle.
Rice Blast.prevention_kn: ರೋಗ ನಿರೋಧಕ ತಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ. ಎಲೆ ಕವಚ ಗಟ್ಟಿಯಾಗಲು ಪೊಟ್ಯಾಷ್ ಗೊಬ್ಬರವನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಪಕವಾಗಿ ನೀಡಿ.
Rice Blast.approved_target_disease: Leaf Blast, Node Blast, Neck Blast
Rice Blast.label_rate: 0.6 g per Litre of water (120 g in 200 Litres of water per acre)
Rice Blast.application_method: High-volume foliar spray using knapsack sprayer with hollow-cone nozzle. Spray at first appearance of leaf blast, repeated at late boot/heading if cloudy/rainy.
Rice Blast.safety_precautions: Wear rubber gloves, protective face mask, and eye goggles. Do not spray against the wind. Keep away from water bodies.
Rice Blast.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Brown Spot.symptoms_en: Circular to oval sesame seed-shaped brown spots with dark reddish-brown margins and grayish centers across leaf blades and glumes.
Brown Spot.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಂದು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಎಳ್ಳಿನ ಆಕಾರದ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಲೆಗಳು. ಕಲೆಯ ಮಧ್ಯ ಬೂದು ಬಣ್ಣ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಚು ಗಾಢ ಕಂದು ಬಣ್ಣದಲ್ಲಿದೆ.
Brown Spot.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Correct soil nutrient imbalances: Apply recommended Potash (MOP) and Zinc sulphate (10 kg/acre in deficient soils).
2. Prevent intermittent drought stress: Keep soil continuously moist; brown spot thrives in drought-stressed, nutrient-deficient soils.
3. Seed treatment: Soak seeds in Carbendazim 2g/kg or hot water before nursery sowing.
Brown Spot.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪೊಟ್ಯಾಷ್ ಮತ್ತು ಸತುವಿನ (Zinc) ಕೊರತೆಯನ್ನು ಸರಿಪಡಿಸಿ. ಎಕರೆಗೆ 10 ಕೆಜಿ ಸತುವಿನ ಸಲ್ಫೇಟ್ ಬಳಸಿ.
2. ಗದ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಒಣಗಲು ಬಿಡಬೇಡಿ; ಸಮರ್ಪಕವಾಗಿ ನೀರು ಹರಿಸಿ.
3. ಬಿತ್ತನೆಗೆ ಮುನ್ನ ಬೀಜೋಪಚಾರ ಕಡ್ಡಾಯವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
Brown Spot.prevention_en: Soil testing, application of well-decomposed FYM (farmyard manure), and balanced N-P-K nutrition.
Brown Spot.prevention_kn: ಮಣ್ಣು ಪರೀಕ್ಷೆ ಮಾಡಿಸಿ ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ಕಳಿತ ಕೊಟ್ಟಿಗೆ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮತೋಲಿತ ರಸಗೊಬ್ಬರಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ.
Brown Spot.label_rate: 2.0 to 2.5 g per Litre of water (400–500 g in 200 Litres of water per acre)
Brown Spot.application_method: Foliar spray targeting upper and middle canopy as soon as spots exceed 5-10% of leaf area.
Brown Spot.safety_precautions: Toxic to fish and aquatic fauna. Wear personal protective clothing. Wash hands and exposed skin thoroughly after handling.
Brown Spot.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Bacterial Leaf Blight.disease_name_kn: ದುಂಡಾಣು ಎಲೆ ಕವಚ / ರಕ್ತ ಸುರುಳಿ ರೋಗ
Bacterial Leaf Blight.symptoms_en: Water-soaked lesions on leaf margins turning yellow-white with wavy edges, rapidly drying into bleached straw-colored blight.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆಯ ತುದಿಯಿಂದ ಮತ್ತು ಅಂಚಿನಿಂದ ಹಳದಿ-ಬಿಳಿ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಒಣಗುವಿಕೆ. ಅಂಚುಗಳು ಅಲೆಯಾಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಒಣಗಿ ಒಣಹುಲ್ಲಿನಂತೆ ಬಿಳಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Strictly STOP nitrogen top-dressing; excess urea accelerates bacterial spread dramatically.
2. Drain stagnant floodwater from affected fields to dry out root zones.
3. Do not clip seedling leaves during transplanting as open wounds allow bacterial entry.
4. Avoid field-to-field irrigation flow from contaminated fields.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ತಕ್ಷಣ ಯೂರಿಯಾ (ಸಾರಜನಕ) ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ನೀಡುವುದನ್ನು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ; ಯೂರಿಯಾ ಈ ರೋಗವನ್ನು ಉಲ್ಬಣಗೊಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
2. ಗದ್ದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನಿಂತ ನೀರನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಬಸಿದು ಹಾಕಿ.
3. ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಎಲೆಯ ತುದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಬೇಡಿ.
4. ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಗದ್ದೆಯ ನೀರನ್ನು ಬೇರೆ ಗದ್ದೆಗಳಿಗೆ ಹರಿಸಬೇಡಿ.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.prevention_en: Plant resistant hybrids (e.g. Improved Samba Mahsuri, RP Bio-226). Disinfect seed stock.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.prevention_kn: ರೋಗ ನಿರೋಧಕ ತಳಿಗಳನ್ನು (ಇಂಪ್ರೂವ್ಡ್ ಸಾಂಬಾ ಮಸೂರಿ) ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ. ಗದ್ದೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಳೆಮುಕ್ತವಾಗಿಡಿ.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.active_ingredient: Streptomycin Sulphate 90% + Tetracycline Hydrochloride 10% SP tank-mixed with Copper Oxychloride 50% WP
Bacterial Leaf Blight.approved_target_disease: Bacterial Leaf Blight (BLB), Bacterial Leaf Streak
Bacterial Leaf Blight.label_rate: Streptocycline 6 g + Copper Oxychloride 100 g in 50 Litres of water (12 g Streptocycline + 200 g Copper Oxychloride in 100 L/acre)
Bacterial Leaf Blight.application_method: Foliar spray during early morning or late afternoon. Spray within 24 hours of mixing.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.safety_precautions: Do not mix with acidic chemicals. Wear protective eyewear and respiratory mask during mixing and spraying.
Bacterial Leaf Blight.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Sheath Blight.symptoms_en: Greenish-gray oval snake-skin patterned lesions with dark borders on leaf sheaths near water surface, spreading up into the leaf canopy.
Sheath Blight.symptoms_kn: ನೀರಿನ ಮಟ್ಟದ ಮೇಲಿರುವ ಹಾಳೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಾವಿನ ಚರ್ಮದಂತಹ ಅಥವಾ ಹಸಿರು-ಬೂದು ಬಣ್ಣದ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಅಂಡಾಕಾರದ ಮಚ್ಚೆಗಳು.
Sheath Blight.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Drain stagnant field water for 3–5 days to let canopy dry out.
2. Remove lower diseased sheaths in isolated patches.
3. Avoid excessive planting density (maintain 20 × 15 cm spacing).
Sheath Blight.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಗದ್ದೆಯಿಂದ ನೀರನ್ನು 3-4 ದಿನ ಬಸಿದು ಬುಡಕ್ಕೆ ಗಾಳಿ ಆಡುವಂತೆ ಮಾಡಿ.
2. ಗಿಡಗಳು ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ದಟ್ಟವಾಗಿರದಂತೆ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
3. ಕಳೆಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣವಾಗಿ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಿ.
Sheath Blight.prevention_en: Apply balanced potassium. Deep plowing in summer to bury sclerotial fungal bodies.
Sheath Blight.prevention_kn: ಬೇಸಿಗೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಆಳವಾದ ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ. ಸಮತೋಲಿತ ಪೊಟ್ಯಾಷ್ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ನೀಡಿ.
Sheath Blight.label_rate: 2.0 to 2.5 mL per Litre of water (400–500 mL in 200 Litres water per acre)
Sheath Blight.application_method: Directed spray thoroughly wetting the lower leaf sheaths and base of tillers near water line.
Sheath Blight.safety_precautions: Bio-antibiotic fungicide with low mammalian toxicity. Use PPE. Wash equipment thoroughly after use.
Sheath Blight.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

False Smut.symptoms_en: Individual grains converted into large, velvety greenish-yellow or orange-black spore balls with powdery texture.
False Smut.symptoms_kn: ತೆನೆಯ ಕೆಲವೇ ಕಾಳುಗಳು ಉಬ್ಬಿ ಹಳದಿ, ಕಿತ್ತಳೆ ಅಥವಾ ಹಸಿರು-ಕಪ್ಪು ಮೃದು ಉಂಡೆಗಳಾಗಿ ಮಾರ್ಪಡುತ್ತವೆ.
False Smut.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Hand-pick and destroy false smut spore balls into plastic bags before spores burst.
2. Avoid late-season nitrogen top-dressing at booting/flowering stage.
3. Rogue out heavily infected panicles immediately.
False Smut.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ತೆನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಜಾಗರೂಕತೆಯಿಂದ ಪ್ಲಾಸ್ಟಿಕ್ ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಿತ್ತು ಸುಟ್ಟುಹಾಕಿ.
2. ಹೂವಾಡುವ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಅತಿಯಾದ ಯೂರಿಯಾ ಹಾಕಬೇಡಿ.
False Smut.prevention_en: Seed treatment with Carbendazim (2g/kg). Adjust sowing date to avoid flowering during rainy/cloudy weeks.
False Smut.prevention_kn: ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕೃತ ಬೀಜೋಪಚಾರ ಮಾಡಿ. ಹೂವಾಡುವ ಸಮಯ ಮಳೆಗಾಲಕ್ಕೆ ಸಿಗದಂತೆ ಬಿತ್ತನೆ ಹೊಂದಿಸಿ.
False Smut.approved_target_disease: False Smut, Sheath Blight, Dirty Panicle
False Smut.label_rate: 1.0 mL per Litre of water (200 mL in 200 Litres of water per acre)
False Smut.application_method: Preventive foliar spray at boot leaf stage (just prior to panicle emergence) and repeated at 50% flowering.
False Smut.safety_precautions: Do not apply during windy conditions. Do not contaminate irrigation canals or fish ponds. Wear protective mask.
False Smut.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Tungro.pathogen_type: Viral (Rice Tungro Virus transmitted by Green Leafhopper)
Tungro.symptoms_en: Yellow-orange leaf discoloration from tips downwards, severe plant stunting, reduced tillering, delayed flowering.
Tungro.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆಗಳು ತುದಿಯಿಂದ ಕಿತ್ತಳೆ-ಹಳದಿ ಬಣ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗಿ ಗಿಡಗಳು ಕುಬ್ಜವಾಗುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ಕವಲುಗಳು ಕಡಿಮೆಯಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.
Tungro.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Immediately rogue out and bury stunted virus-infected hills to eliminate inoculum source.
2. Install light traps in field (1 trap per acre) to monitor and attract vector green leafhoppers.
3. Synchronize planting with neighboring farmers to avoid continuous vector breeding.
Tungro.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಕುಬ್ಜ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರು ಸಹಿತ ಕಿತ್ತು ಮಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಹೂತುಹಾಕಿ.
2. ಗದ್ದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬೆಳಕು ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು (Light traps) ಇರಿಸಿ ಜಿಗಿಹುಳುಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಶಪಡಿಸಿ.
3. ಹಳ್ಳಿಯ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ರೈತರು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ನಿಗದಿತ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
Tungro.prevention_en: Plant resistant cultivars (Vikramarya, Lalat). Control nursery leafhoppers before transplanting.
Tungro.prevention_kn: ತುಂಗ್ರೊ ನಿರೋಧಕ ತಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ. ಮಡಿ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲೇ ಜಿಗಿಹುಳುಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಿ.
Tungro.active_ingredient: Imidacloprid 17.8% SL (Vector Control - Kills Green Leafhopper)
Tungro.approved_target_disease: Green Leafhopper (Nephotettix virescens) - Vector of Tungro Virus
Tungro.label_rate: 0.3 mL per Litre of water (60 mL in 200 Litres of water per acre)
Tungro.application_method: Foliar spray targeting both foliage and canopy base where leafhoppers feed.
Tungro.safety_precautions: Highly toxic to honeybees. Do not apply when rice is flowering and bees are foraging.
Tungro.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Stem Borer Damage.symptoms_en: 'Dead hearts' (central drying shoot) in vegetative phase; erect, empty white panicles ('White heads') in reproductive phase.
Stem Borer Damage.symptoms_kn: ಸಸಿ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಮಧ್ಯದ ಸುಳಿ ಒಣಗುವುದು (ಡೆಡ್ ಹಾರ್ಟ್), ತೆನೆ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾಳುಗಳಿಲ್ಲದ ಬಿಳಿ ತೆನೆ (White Ear).
Stem Borer Damage.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Clip seedling leaf tips before transplanting to destroy egg masses.
2. Install pheromone traps (5–8 traps/acre) with Scirpophaga lures for monitoring.
3. Release egg parasitoid Trichogramma japonicum (100,000/ha) at weekly intervals.
Stem Borer Damage.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಸಸಿಗಳ ಎಲೆ ತುದಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಮೊಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಶಪಡಿಸಿ.
2. ಎಕರೆಗೆ 5-8 ಫೆರಮೋನ್ ಬಲೆಗಳನ್ನು (Lure traps) ಇರಿಸಿ.
3. ಟ್ರೈಕೋಗ್ರಾಮ ಪರಾವಲಂಬಿ ಜೈವಿಕ ಕಾರ್ಡ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ.
Stem Borer Damage.prevention_en: Deep summer plowing to destroy overwintering larvae in rice stubble.
Stem Borer Damage.prevention_kn: ಕೊಯ್ಲಿನ ನಂತರ ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ ಬತ್ತದ ಬುಡದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಹುಳುಗಳನ್ನು ನಾಶಪಡಿಸಿ.
Stem Borer Damage.label_rate: 0.3 mL per Litre of water (60 mL in 200 Litres of water per acre)
Stem Borer Damage.application_method: Foliar spray at economic threshold (ETL: 1 egg mass/m² or 5% dead hearts).
Stem Borer Damage.safety_precautions: Wear overalls, rubber boots, and face protection. Keep out of reach of children and domestic animals.
Stem Borer Damage.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Rice Hispa.symptoms_en: Parallel white lines on leaf blades from larval and adult chlorophyll scraping; affected leaves wither and appear bleached like dried straw.
Rice Hispa.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಬಿಳಿ ಬಣ್ಣದ ಸಮಾನಾಂತರ ರೇಖೆಗಳು; ದುಂಬಿಗಳು ಹಸಿರನ್ನು ಕೆರೆದು ತಿನ್ನುವುದರಿಂದ ಎಲೆ ಒಣಗಿ ಬಿಳಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
Rice Hispa.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Clip top 5 cm of seedling leaves before transplanting (removes 80% of eggs).
2. Pass a sweep net or rope across flooded canopy to dislodge adult beetles.
3. Clear alternate host grasses on field bunds.
Rice Hispa.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡುವಾಗ ಎಲೆಯ ತುದಿಯ 5 ಸೆಂ.ಮೀ ಕತ್ತರಿಸಿ ಮೊಟ್ಟೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆಯಿರಿ.
2. ಗದ್ದೆಯ ಬದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಕಳೆ ಹುಲ್ಲನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದುಹಾಕಿ.
3. ನೀರಿನ ಮೇಲೆ ಹಗ್ಗ ಅಥವಾ ಬಲೆಯನ್ನು ಎಳೆದು ದುಂಬಿಗಳನ್ನು ಸಂಗ್ರಹಿಸಿ ನಾಶಪಡಿಸಿ.
Rice Hispa.prevention_en: Avoid staggered planting in hispa-endemic areas.
Rice Hispa.prevention_kn: ಒಂದೇ ಪ್ರದೇಶದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಲ್ಲ ರೈತರು ಒಟ್ಟಾಗಿ ನಾಟಿ ಮಾಡಿ.
Rice Hispa.approved_target_disease: Rice Hispa, Stem Borer, Gall Midge
Rice Hispa.label_rate: 2.0 mL per Litre of water (400 mL in 200 Litres water per acre)
Rice Hispa.application_method: Foliar spray when hispa damage exceeds 2 damaged leaves/hill or 1 adult beetle/hill.
Rice Hispa.safety_precautions: Organophosphate pesticide. Highly toxic. Wear complete chemical apron, face shield, and chemical-resistant gloves. Avoid inhalation.
Rice Hispa.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Bakanae.symptoms_en: Abnormally tall, slender, pale yellowish seedlings with adventitious roots emerging from lower stem nodes, ultimately wilting.
Bakanae.symptoms_kn: ಕೆಲವೇ ಗಿಡಗಳು ಉಳಿದ ಗಿಡಗಳಿಗಿಂತ ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ಉದ್ದವಾಗಿ, ತೆಳುವಾಗಿ ಮತ್ತು ಹಳದಿಯಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆದು ನಂತರ ಸಾಯುತ್ತವೆ.
Bakanae.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Carefully uproot and burn elongated infected plants before fungal sporulation.
2. Mandatory seed inspection: Do NOT use seeds from bakanae-infected fields.
3. Hot water seed treatment (52–54°C for 10 min) kills internal fungal mycelium.
Bakanae.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ಉದ್ದವಾಗಿರುವ ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಬೇರು ಸಮೇತ ಕಿತ್ತು ಸುಟ್ಟುಹಾಕಿ.
2. ಈ ಗದ್ದೆಯ ಭತ್ತವನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿನ ಬಿತ್ತನೆ ಬೀಜವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಬೇಡಿ.
3. ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರಿನ ಬೀಜೋಪಚಾರ ಮಾಡಿ.
Bakanae.prevention_en: Certified pathogen-free seed stock. Bio-seed treatment with Trichoderma viride.
Bakanae.prevention_kn: ರೈತ ಸಂಪರ್ಕ ಕೇಂದ್ರದಿಂದ ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕೃತ ಬೀಜ ಪಡೆಯಿರಿ.
Bakanae.label_rate: 2.0 g per kg of seed (dry or wet seed dressing) or 1.0 g / L water as nursery drench
Bakanae.application_method: Seed treatment prior to nursery sowing. Soak seeds in Carbendazim solution for 24 hours.
Bakanae.safety_precautions: Wash hands and utensils immediately after seed dressing. Do not feed treated seeds to birds or cattle.
Bakanae.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Bacterial Leaf Streak.symptoms_en: Fine, translucent, water-soaked brownish streaks strictly confined between leaf veins, producing small bacterial exudate droplets in moist weather.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆ ನರಗಳ ನಡುವೆ ಕಿರಿದಾದ, ನೀರಿನಂಶದ ಕಂದು ಗೆರೆಗಳು. ತೇವಾಂಶವಿದ್ದಾಗ ಸಣ್ಣ ಬಿಳಿ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ ಹನಿಗಳು ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Stop top-dressing with nitrogenous fertilizers.
2. Drain stagnant water and let field surface aerate.
3. Prevent injury to leaves during intercultural operations.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಸಾರಜನಕ (ಯೂರಿಯಾ) ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಹಾಕುವುದು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ.
2. ಗದ್ದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸದೆ ಒಣಗಲು ಬಿಡಿ.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.prevention_en: Crop sanitation, removal of grassy weeds, and balanced potassium.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.prevention_kn: ಕಳೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪೊಟ್ಯಾಷ್ ಸಮರ್ಪಕ ಬಳಕೆ.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.label_rate: 2.5 g per Litre of water (500 g in 200 Litres water per acre)
Bacterial Leaf Streak.application_method: Foliar spray wetting both sides of leaf canopy.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.safety_precautions: Wear mask and goggles. Avoid spraying during strong winds.
Bacterial Leaf Streak.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Sheath Rot.symptoms_en: Oblong or irregular reddish-brown lesions with gray centers on boot leaf sheath; incomplete panicle emergence with chaffy grains.
Sheath Rot.symptoms_kn: ಧ್ವಜ ಎಲೆಯ ಕವಚದ ಮೇಲೆ ಬೂದು ಮಧ್ಯಭಾಗವಿರುವ ಅಸಮವಾದ ಕಂದು ಮಚ್ಚೆಗಳು; ತೆನೆ ಹೊರಬಾರದೆ ಅರ್ಧಂಬರ್ಧ ಸಿಲುಕಿ ಕೊಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.
Sheath Rot.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Manage stem borers and mites, whose feeding wounds allow fungal entry.
2. Maintain optimal plant spacing (20 × 15 cm) to avoid canopy humidity.
Sheath Rot.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಕಾಂಡ ಕೊರೆಯುವ ಹುಳುಗಳನ್ನು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಿಸಿ.
2. ಗಿಡಗಳು ದಟ್ಟವಾಗಿರದಂತೆ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
Sheath Rot.prevention_en: Use clean certified seeds. Avoid excess nitrogen at booting.
Sheath Rot.label_rate: 2.0 mL per Litre of water (400 mL in 200 Litres of water per acre)
Sheath Rot.application_method: Directed spray thoroughly covering boot leaf sheaths at booting stage.
Sheath Rot.safety_precautions: Wear rubber gloves. Do not contaminate irrigation canals or ponds.
Sheath Rot.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.symptoms_en: Short, narrow, linear brown streaks (2 to 10 mm long) running parallel to leaf veins.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆಯ ನರಗಳಿಗೆ ಸಮಾನಾಂತರವಾಗಿ ಸಣ್ಣ, ಕಿರಿದಾದ ಕಂದು ಬಣ್ಣದ ರೇಖೆಗಳು.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Apply recommended potassium fertilizer (MOP) to improve foliar resistance.
2. In most fields this is a late-season minor disease; chemical treatment is rarely necessary.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಪೊಟ್ಯಾಷ್ ಗೊಬ್ಬರವನ್ನು ಸಮರ್ಪಕವಾಗಿ ನೀಡಿ.
2. ಇದು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕೊನೆಯ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವುದರಿಂದ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಸಿಂಪಡಣೆ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.prevention_en: Balanced fertilizer application and resistant cultivars.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.prevention_kn: ಸಮತೋಲಿತ ರಸಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರೋಧಕ ತಳಿಗಳ ಬಳಕೆ.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.approved_target_disease: Narrow Brown Leaf Spot, Brown Spot
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.label_rate: 2.0 g per Litre of water (only if more than 20% foliage is affected before heading)
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.safety_precautions: Standard PPE required. Avoid spraying on hot sunny afternoons.
Narrow Brown Leaf Spot.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Bacterial Panicle Blight.symptoms_en: Brownish discoloration of florets and panicles during flowering; grains fail to fill, resulting in upright empty panicles.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.symptoms_kn: ಹೂವಾಡುವ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ತೆನೆಯ ಕಾಳುಗಳು ಕಂದು ಬಣ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗಿ ಜಳ್ಳಾಗುತ್ತವೆ; ತೆನೆ ನೆಟ್ಟಗೆ ನಿಂತಿರುತ್ತದೆ.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.nonchemical_management_en:
1. No synthetic chemical is registered by CIBRC specifically for Burkholderia glumae panicle blight.
2. Do NOT apply fungicides, as this is a bacterial infection and fungicides have zero effect.
3. Do not apply late nitrogen fertilizer.
4. Obtain disease-free certified seed from government extension stations.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಈ ರೋಗಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಶಿಲೀಂಧ್ರನಾಶಕವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಬೇಡಿ (ಇದು ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ ರೋಗ).
2. ಹೂಬಿಡುವಾಗ ಅತಿಯಾದ ಯೂರಿಯಾ ಹಾಕಬೇಡಿ.
3. ಮುಂದಿನ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಶುದ್ಧ ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕೃತ ಬೀಜವನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.prevention_en: Seed sanitation and adjusting planting dates away from excessive heat/humidity at flowering.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.active_ingredient: None registered specifically for this pathogen in India
Bacterial Panicle Blight.label_rate: Please consult your local agricultural officer for a verified treatment recommendation.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.safety_precautions: Do not spray unauthorized or unregistered chemicals.
Bacterial Panicle Blight.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Leaf Smut.symptoms_en: Small, angular, lead-black to dark brown slightly raised spots (0.5 to 2 mm) scattered across mature leaves.
Leaf Smut.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಣ್ಣ, ಕಪ್ಪು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಉಬ್ಬಿದ ಮಚ್ಚೆಗಳು. ಎಲೆಯ ಎರಡೂ ಬದಿಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಕಂಡುಬರುತ್ತವೆ.
Leaf Smut.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Leaf smut occurs late in the season and rarely causes economic yield loss in commercial rice fields.
2. Chemical pesticide application is generally NOT recommended or economically justified.
3. Plow crop residues deeply after harvest to bury fungal spores.
Leaf Smut.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಇದು ಕೊಯ್ಲಿನ ಕೊನೆಯ ಹಂತದಲ್ಲಿ ಬರುವುದರಿಂದ ಬೆಳೆಗೆ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ನಷ್ಟ ಮಾಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
2. ಇದಕ್ಕೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಕೀಟನಾಶಕ ಅಥವಾ ಔಷಧಿಯ ಅಗತ್ಯವಿಲ್ಲ.
3. ಕೊಯ್ಲಿನ ನಂತರ ಗದ್ದೆಯನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಉಳುಮೆ ಮಾಡಿ.
Leaf Smut.prevention_en: Avoid excessive late-season nitrogen top-dressing. Maintain normal planting density.
Leaf Smut.active_ingredient: None required (Economically insignificant in general production)
Leaf Smut.label_rate: Chemical spray not economically warranted. Please consult local RSK officer if severe.
Leaf Smut.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Rice Grassy Stunt.pathogen_type: Viral (Rice Grassy Stunt Virus transmitted by Brown Planthopper)
Rice Grassy Stunt.symptoms_en: Severe plant stunting, excessive erect narrow tillers giving a grassy clump appearance, leaves pale green or mottled.
Rice Grassy Stunt.symptoms_kn: ಗಿಡಗಳು ಹುಲ್ಲಿನ ಕುರ್ಚಿಯಂತೆ ಚಿಕ್ಕದಾಗುತ್ತವೆ. ಅತಿಯಾದ ಸಣ್ಣ ಸಣ್ಣ ಕವಲುಗಳು, ತೆನೆಗಳು ಬರುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
Rice Grassy Stunt.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Rogue out and bury severely stunted virus-infected plants.
2. Practice Alternate Wetting and Drying (AWD) irrigation to break planthopper reproduction.
3. Leave 30 cm alleyways every 2–3 meters in field to increase aeration and sunlight.
Rice Grassy Stunt.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಕುಬ್ಜ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಪಡಿಸಿ.
2. ಗದ್ದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸದೆ ಆಗಾಗ ಆರಿಸಿ ನೀರು ಹರಿಸಿ.
3. ಗದ್ದೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿ 2-3 ಮೀಟರ್‌ಗೆ ಗಾಳಿ ಆಡಲು ಹಾದಿ ಬಿಡಿ.
Rice Grassy Stunt.prevention_en: Grow BPH-resistant varieties. Conserve mirid bugs and spiders that eat planthoppers.
Rice Grassy Stunt.prevention_kn: ಕಂದು ಜಿಗಿಹುಳು ನಿರೋಧಕ ತಳಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬೆಳೆಯಿರಿ. ಉಪಕಾರಿ ಕೀಟಗಳನ್ನು ರಕ್ಷಿಸಿ.
Rice Grassy Stunt.active_ingredient: Pymetrozine 50% WG (Vector Control - Kills Brown Planthopper)
Rice Grassy Stunt.approved_target_disease: Brown Planthopper (Nilaparvata lugens) - Vector of Grassy Stunt
Rice Grassy Stunt.label_rate: 0.6 g per Litre of water (120 g in 200 Litres water per acre)
Rice Grassy Stunt.application_method: Directed spray to the base of tillers near water level where planthoppers congregate.
Rice Grassy Stunt.safety_precautions: Specialized planthopper insecticide. Low toxicity to predatory spiders. Wear PPE.
Rice Grassy Stunt.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Rice Ragged Stunt.pathogen_type: Viral (Rice Ragged Stunt Virus transmitted by Brown Planthopper)
Rice Ragged Stunt.symptoms_en: Stunted plants, twisted and ragged leaf margins with serrated appearance, presence of small vein swellings (galls) on leaf undersides.
Rice Ragged Stunt.symptoms_kn: ಎಲೆಯ ಅಂಚುಗಳು ಹರಿದು ಗರಗಸದಂತೆ ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ. ಎಲೆಗಳು ಸುರುಟಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತವೆ ಮತ್ತು ನರಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಸಣ್ಣ ಗಂಟುಗಳು ಉಂಟಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.
Rice Ragged Stunt.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Destroy infected volunteer rice plants and weeds.
2. Vector management (Brown Planthopper) is the only control method for virus spread.
3. Alternate wetting and drying (AWD) water management.
Rice Ragged Stunt.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ಗಿಡಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ನಾಶಪಡಿಸಿ.
2. ಕಂದು ಜಿಗಿಹುಳುಗಳ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣಕ್ಕೆ ಆದ್ಯತೆ ನೀಡಿ.
Rice Ragged Stunt.prevention_en: Plant resistant cultivars. Avoid excessive urea.
Rice Ragged Stunt.prevention_kn: ನಿರೋಧಕ ತಳಿಗಳ ಬಳಕೆ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮತೋಲಿತ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ.
Rice Ragged Stunt.label_rate: 0.48 mL per Litre of water (94 mL in 200 Litres of water per acre)
Rice Ragged Stunt.application_method: Foliar spray directed to base of plant canopy.
Rice Ragged Stunt.safety_precautions: Follow label instructions strictly. Wear protective mask and gloves.
Rice Ragged Stunt.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Dirty Panicle.symptoms_en: Dark brown, black, or reddish spots on glumes; discolored kernel, high chaffiness and broken grains during milling.
Dirty Panicle.symptoms_kn: ತೆನೆಯ ಭತ್ತದ ಕಾಳುಗಳ ಮೇಲೆ ಕಂದು, ಕಪ್ಪು ಅಥವಾ ಬೂದು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಮಚ್ಚೆಗಳು. ಕಾಳುಗಳು ಜಳ್ಳಾಗುತ್ತವೆ.
Dirty Panicle.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Avoid late nitrogen top-dressing at booting/panicle emergence.
2. Keep fields properly drained during maturity; do not allow late stagnant water.
3. Harvest on time when 80-85% grains turn straw-golden.
Dirty Panicle.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ತೆನೆ ಬರುವಾಗ ಸಾರಜನಕ ಅತಿಯಾಗಿ ಹಾಕಬೇಡಿ.
2. ಕಾಳು ಕಟ್ಟುವ ಸಮಯದಲ್ಲಿ ನೀರು ಕೊರತೆಯಾಗದಂತೆ ನೋಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
3. ಸರಿಯಾದ ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ (ಶೇ. 80-85 ಕಾಳುಗಳು ಬಂಗಾರದ ಬಣ್ಣಕ್ಕೆ ತಿರುಗಿದಾಗ) ಕೊಯ್ಲು ಮಾಡಿ.
Dirty Panicle.prevention_en: Seed treatment and clean threshing yards.
Dirty Panicle.approved_target_disease: Grain Discoloration (Dirty Panicle), Sheath Blight, Blast
Dirty Panicle.label_rate: 0.4 g per Litre of water (80 g in 200 Litres of water per acre)
Dirty Panicle.safety_precautions: Combination fungicide. Wear full protective gear. Do not spray within 3 weeks of expected harvest.
Dirty Panicle.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Kernel Smut.symptoms_en: Individual grains burst open at maturity releasing black powdery sooty spores, soiling the entire panicle during threshing.
Kernel Smut.symptoms_kn: ಭತ್ತದ ಕಾಳುಗಳು ಒಡೆದು ಒಳಭಾಗದಿಂದ ಕಪ್ಪು ಮಸಿಯಂತಹ ಪುಡಿ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
Kernel Smut.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Do NOT use seeds from infected fields for future crops.
2. Rogue out and destroy affected panicles before spores contaminate soil.
3. Avoid excessive nitrogen fertilizer.
Kernel Smut.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಈ ಗದ್ದೆಯ ಬೀಜವನ್ನು ಬಿತ್ತನೆಗೆ ಬಳಸಬೇಡಿ.
2. ರೋಗಪೀಡಿತ ತೆನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಕಿತ್ತು ಸುಟ್ಟುಹಾಕಿ.
3. ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಸಾರಜನಕ ಗೊಬ್ಬರ ಹಾಕಬೇಡಿ.
Kernel Smut.prevention_en: Crop rotation and certified seed dressing.
Kernel Smut.label_rate: 1.0 mL per Litre of water (200 mL in 200 Litres water per acre)
Kernel Smut.application_method: Foliar spray at boot stage prior to heading.
Kernel Smut.safety_precautions: Wear PPE. Do not contaminate ponds or water sources.
Kernel Smut.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026

Udbatta Disease.symptoms_en: Entire panicle glued into an erect, cylindrical, hard, ash-white or grayish-black rod resembling an incense stick; 100% loss of grain on affected tillers.
Udbatta Disease.symptoms_kn: ತೆನೆಗಳು ಅರಳದೆ, ಅಗರ್‌ಬತ್ತಿಯ ಕಡ್ಡಿಯಂತೆ ನೇರವಾಗಿ, ಬಿಳಿ-ಬೂದು ಬಣ್ಣದ ಸಿಲಿಂಡರ್ ಆಕಾರದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೊರಬರುತ್ತವೆ. ಒಂದೂ ಕಾಳು ಕಟ್ಟುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.
Udbatta Disease.nonchemical_management_en:
1. Immediately cut and burn all 'incense stick' panicles in plastic bags.
2. NEVER harvest seeds from udbatta-infected fields (the fungus is internally seed-borne).
3. Hot water seed treatment: Soak seeds in water at 52–54°C for 10 minutes.
Udbatta Disease.nonchemical_management_kn:
1. ಉದ್ಬತ್ತಿ ಕಡ್ಡಿಯಂತಿರುವ ತೆನೆಗಳನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಕಿತ್ತು ಚೀಲದಲ್ಲಿ ಹಾಕಿ ಸುಟ್ಟುಹಾಕಿ.
2. ಈ ಗದ್ದೆಯ ಭತ್ತವನ್ನು ಮುಂದಿನ ಬಿತ್ತನೆ ಬೀಜವಾಗಿ ಬಳಸಬೇಡಿ.
3. ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರಿನ ಬೀಜೋಪಚಾರ (52-54 ಡಿಗ್ರಿ ಸೆಲ್ಸಿಯಸ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ 10 ನಿಮಿಷ) ಮಾಡಿ.
Udbatta Disease.prevention_en: Hot water seed soak followed by chemical seed dressing with Carbendazim.
Udbatta Disease.prevention_kn: ಬಿಸಿ ನೀರಿನ ಬೀಜೋಪಚಾರ ಮತ್ತು ಕಾರ್ಬೆಂಡಾಜಿಮ್ ಬೀಜೋಪಚಾರ.
Udbatta Disease.label_rate: 2.0 g per kg seed (wet seed soak for 24 hours prior to nursery incubation)
Udbatta Disease.application_method: Pre-sowing seed soak. Note: Foliar sprays after udbatta symptoms emerge are INEFFECTIVE because infection occurs through seed embryo.
Udbatta Disease.safety_precautions: Foliar chemical sprays cannot cure emerged udbatta panicles. Focus strictly on clean certified seed stock and seed treatment.
Udbatta Disease.source_url: CIBRC Government of India Registered Formulations & UAS Rice Package of Practices 2026
